intro.text: A chain of islands in the Reshi Sea of Roshar, some of whose people are known for painting the shells of their chulls.

description.text: The Reshi travel the sea in catamarans. Their furniture is flat and long, and they sit on cushions instead of chairs.
Most Reshi have little concept of real war: when two tai-na fight, their people row out and trade insults, weakest first, before a few arrows fly. The eastern Reshi, though, raid Alethkar.
The Reshi Isles lie near the equator, so the weather is warm and overwhelmingly humid, and rain on the Reshi Sea forms a misty haze.
Some Reshi islands are tai-na, huge greatshells the size of islands that the Reshi live on and worship. Each island has its own king, with its own customs.

items.text: Around 1155 the Akak Reshi fought the Alethi and were destroyed; Dalinar, a general on the Alethi side, claimed their land for Alethkar.
The losses dealt a heavy blow to the nearby Reshi, but they kept raiding the Alethi borders.
The Reshi trade only with individuals they trust, mostly in the trading season. Rysn and her babsk Vstim came to one island to trade with its king.
During the True Desolation, the coalition invited the Reshi king Ral-na and his son to Urithiru.
